# Murmur

> Murmur turns a spoken product idea into a project foundation in under 10 minutes: a competitor map with source links, a PRD, a brand kit, an engineering brief, a three-phase roadmap, and a Jira project (epics + stories) and Confluence space created in the user's own Atlassian site. It is a foundation, not a finished app.

## Product facts (checked 2026-09-26)

- Input: a voice memo of 15 seconds to 10 minutes, recorded on phone or desktop. Typing the idea also works.
- Pipeline: transcription (AssemblyAI) → competitor and market research with source links (Exa) → PRD (Claude; MoSCoW features, typically with a rationale per feature; success metrics, non-goals, risks, open questions) → brand kit (name notes, tagline, values, color palette, typography, logo direction) → engineering brief (architecture, data flow, components, data models, SQL/TypeScript schema, tech stack, tasks) → Confluence space with six pages → roadmap (three phases) → Jira project with epics and stories.
- Run time: under 10 minutes. The four public example runs took 7m 02s to 9m 22s.
- Atlassian: a free Atlassian account is enough. Murmur creates a new Jira project and Confluence space in the user's own site for each idea.
- Exports: Markdown for the PRD, research, engineering brief and transcript; a brand-kit zip.
- Privacy: runs are private to the account; results are kept for one month (six months on Builder and Studio), then deleted.
- Availability: waitlist with invites in batches (September 2026).

## Pricing (USD)

- First idea: free, every account.
- Pay as you go: $7 per idea, no subscription.
- Starter: $19/month, 5 ideas. Builder: $49/month, 15 ideas. Studio: $79/month, 30 ideas.
- Failed runs never use an idea. Founding offer: the first 50 subscribers get double their tier's idea allowance for 12 months.

## Real example runs (unedited output)

- [Creature Clash: mobile creature-battler game prototype](https://www.trymurmur.studio/examples/creature-clash): 2:56 memo, 9m 22s run, 12 epics, 47 stories.
- [ShipReel: launch-video SaaS for founders](https://www.trymurmur.studio/examples/shipreel): 0:49 memo, 7m 02s run, 11 epics, 33 stories.
- [Aavaas: AI home-design and floor-plan tool](https://www.trymurmur.studio/examples/aavaas): 1:57 memo, 7m 42s run, 11 epics, 39 stories.
- [Fin Matter: personal AI finance assistant](https://www.trymurmur.studio/examples/fin-matter): 2:57 memo, 7m 31s run, 11 epics, 41 stories.
